outputs: Generated explanations for diagnosis and prediction labels

The outputs are predicted labels (Patient/Control) for Alzheimer's Disease detection based on picture description tasks, along with interpretive reasoning generated via guided Chain-of-Thought prompting.

quote: For evaluation metrics, we use (1) Accuracy (ACC), (2) Area Under the Curve (AUC) which captures the ability to distinguish between Patient and Control under different thresholds, (3) Sensitivity (SEN): the True Positive rate for Patient detection, and (4) Specificity (SPE): the True Negative rate for Control detection.
